# Parse file names and create necessary directories.
import os

base_abs = "/home/sierra/documents/work/meetings_data/"
file_names = set()
for fp in file_paths:
    # Get the file name part
    fname = fp.split("/")[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = fname.split("__", 1)
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    # e.g., "slides.ppt" -> file_name="slides", ext="ppt"
    # "video_recording.mp4" -> file_name="video_recording", ext="mp4"
    # There might be dots in file_name? but likely not. We'll split on last dot.
    if "." in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    else:
        # no extension? unlikely
        file_name = rest
        ext = ""
    file_names.add(file_name)
    print(f"date={date_part}, file_name={file_name}, ext={ext}")

print("Unique file names:", file_names)

# Move each file to its new location: <file_name>/<date>.<ext>
import os

for src in file_paths:
    # Extract filename from path
    fname = os.path.basename(src)
    # Split into date and rest (e.g., "2023-apr-04__slides.ppt")
    date_part, rest = fname.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest into file_name and extension
